title: WorkflowSeedContext
description: Reference definitions (not an artifact kind, no manifest entry, no single root object to validate) for context assumed to be available as independently-seeded workflow variables — never nested under one combined wrapper. 'company' (see definitions.company below) is seeded as tnsw/trade/trade_workflow.json's own top-level variable named 'traderCompany' (see trade_1_cha_selection's input_mapping); it crosses into tnsw/trade/3-prepare_split_items's build_split_items node as local var 'company', which HSCODE_SPLIT_BUILDER bakes into each split item; inside a SPLIT_TASK-spawned agency flow (e.g. tnsw/npqs/npqs_workflow.json's n1_apply) it's read back out at '_iter.input.company.<field>' — '_iter' being the current split-task iteration context and '.input' that item's own input payload. See .claude/skills/autofill-global-context/SKILL.md for how to wire a new field into a workflow.

company.description: The registered trader company a workflow (or a spawned agency workflow) is running on behalf of. Shape confirmed directly from a real sample payload (2026-09-08) — see per-field notes below for anything inferred rather than directly confirmed.

id.description: Company id in the trader-registry service, e.g. 'adam-pvt-ltd'. Note: this exact value also appears as the example for trade-cha-selection-flow's 'cha_company_id' x-search field (tnsw/trade/1-cha_selection/userinput_jsonform.json) — suggestive that CHAs and trader companies may share this same id space/registry, but that's an observation, not a confirmed fact.

name.description: Company display name, e.g. 'ADAM PVT LTD'. There is only one name field, but the same source key can be mapped to more than one destination field within a single input_mapping (with or without the trailing '?') — e.g. tnsw/npqs/npqs_workflow.json's n1_apply node maps '_iter.input.company.name?' to both 'applicant_name' and 'exporter_name'. Add a distinctly-named field here only if a genuinely separate value (not just a different label) is confirmed to exist.

ouHandle.description: Organizational-unit handle. Equal to 'id' in the one confirmed sample seen so far ('adam-pvt-ltd') — exact relationship to 'id' (always identical vs. coincidence) is not confirmed.

hasCha.description: Meaning not fully confirmed. Most likely: whether this company currently has a CHA associated with it (e.g. to decide whether tnsw/trade/1-cha_selection should default-select one). Verify the exact semantics before branching or autofilling logic on it.

createdAt.description: When this company record was created, e.g. '2026-09-08T14:00:53.413612+05:30'.

updatedAt.description: When this company record was last updated.

data.description: Registry attributes about the company. Note there is no 'address' field anywhere in the confirmed payload — tnsw/npqs/npqs_workflow.json still maps '_iter.input.company.address?' to exporter_address as an optional placeholder pending a real source; it resolves to nothing until an actual address field is confirmed and added here. Confirm and wire the real source once that data is available.

br_no.description: Sri Lanka business registration (BR) number, e.g. 'PV-00123456'.

contact_email.description: Primary contact email on file for the company.

agencies.description: Per-regulatory-agency data about this company, keyed by agency slug (cda/customs/fcau/npqs/sltb, per CLAUDE.md's agency list). Each agency's object shape is agency-specific — there's no shared sub-schema, since what one agency tracks about a registrant has nothing to do with what another does. Only 'npqs' is modeled so far; add a sibling property here (and wire it the same way, via that agency's own macro workflow) when another agency needs its own company-level data. Placement under 'data' (alongside br_no/tin_no/vat_no) is a best-fit guess for consistency with the rest of this object, not yet confirmed against the real payload — move it if the actual data lands elsewhere.

cha.description: The Customs House Agent (CHA) firm an acting session belongs to — a separately-seeded variable from 'company' above, not a field on it. Null/absent when the acting user is not a CHA (e.g. a trader submitting directly) — every consumer must treat it as optional. Not yet wired into any input_mapping: tnsw/trade/trade_workflow.json is trader-initiated, so its 1-cha_selection step (where the trader picks a CHA) has no CHA in its own session to prefill from. Modeled here for a future CHA-initiated flow or CHA-facing view that needs it.

cha_company_id.description: Same id space as trade-cha-selection-flow's 'cha_company_id' field (tnsw/trade/1-cha_selection/userinput_jsonform.json) — this is the value that field's x-search resolves to, e.g. 'adam-pvt-ltd'.

cha_name.description: Display name of the CHA firm.

cha_license_number.description: Sri Lanka Customs CHA license number.

contact_email.description: Primary contact email on file for the CHA firm.

contact_phone.description: Primary contact phone number on file for the CHA firm.
